rationale: The incumbent returned an empty list, giving plan_length=0 and status=goal_unsatisfied on every task. My previous BFS attempt also returned 0-length plans, which suggests the returned value did not reach the evaluator as valid grounded action strings (or an exception fell back). This revision keeps the BFS grounding logic but changes the output encoding to a plain string form "(walk shed location1 bob)" built from groundings that are checked against the declared object types, and wraps grounding/action generation defensively so any unexpected data shape yields a fallback rather than a silent empty plan. Prediction: total_successes increases from 0.
